name: Lyse Hext
oracle_text:
Prowess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
Noncreature spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
As long as you've cast two or more noncreature spells this turn, Lyse Hext has double strike.
blocked_sentences: As long as you've cast two or more noncreature spells this turn, Lyse Hext has double strike.

needs.what: the typed form of spells_cast_this_turn ({"player": "you", "filter": {"not_types": ["Creature"]}}) accepted as a static value, so a grant_keyword static's condition can be a cmp of noncreature spells you cast this turn >= 2
needs.why_existing_wont_do: static_value_keys has spells_cast_this_turn, but only as a bare player spec that counts every spell. cards/loader/statics.py rejects the {player, filter} mapping in a static by name, and characteristics.py reads only the flat turn_ledger.spells_cast total. Only the effect-side value (effects/values.py) can filter by type. Counting all spells would turn double strike on after two creature spells, which is a different and stronger card
